items.title: Harmonized
items.description:
We've harmonized all WELL programs under a single version of the standard. New thematic groupings provide an intuitive, executive-level view, making it easy to pinpoint strategies that align with your goals. Preconditions now qualify for points across the board and every point earned toward a rating is now a point earned toward certification— 
 every step forward counts.

items.title: Clarified
items.description: We've restructured and simplified how each WELL strategy is written, making them more clear, scannable and straightforward to implement. This increased clarity makes WELL easier to translate into different languages and apply across the global market, empowering teams around the world to act with greater precision and confidence.

items.title: Evergreen
items.description: Like an evergreen tree, the WELL Standard experiences surges of new growth each year as science and best practices evolve. It prioritizes gradual enhancement over restructuring, letting you manage all of your projects within the same version of WELL, one that reflects the latest improvements as they are published over time.

items.title: Smarter
items.description: We've invested in the WELL platform to serve as an active partner that tracks progress, celebrates wins and provides clear recommendations toward your next milestone. These enhancements enable continuous progress, helping you drive more value and derive greater benefit from every step of your WELL journey.

tour.subtitle: Explore the new WELL Standard, designed to make every path through WELL clearer, more connected and easier to navigate.

vision.tagline: One standard. One experience. One WELL.

paragraphs.text: Imagine spaces that energize your day. Environments that sharpen your thinking. Policies that protect your health. Places and programs working together to
inspire your best work and your best life.

roadmap.intro: We’re debuting One WELL in phases, starting with public comment and moving toward open enrollment with continuous enhancements now and into the future.

milestones.title: Standard in public comment
milestones.description: The WELL Standard remains available to explore following the close of public comment, as we review feedback and continue shaping the final version.

milestones.title: Finalizing the standard
milestones.description: Insights from public comment will be used to refine and finalize the standard alongside the debut of new process and platform enhancements. The WELL Forum will serve as the hub to preview these developments and provide feedback before they are released.

link.label: Stay in the know in the WELL Forum

milestones.title: Enrollment
milestones.description: Organizations can enroll in the latest version of WELL, allowing them to apply the new standard across their portfolio. Existing customers will have the opportunity to transition their active projects over time.

milestones.title: Ongoing enhancements
milestones.description: Experience regular improvements to the WELL process and platform.

feedback.title: Tell us what you think
